speaker: Doctor
text: Let's start by asking: Have you noticed any trouble swallowing or speaking along with your double vision and weakness? This will help determine if this is a systemic neuromuscular issue.

speaker: Patient
text: The double vision usually happens when I look up or down, and the weakness in my arms and legs gets worse after activity but improves if I rest. I have not noticed balance problems or numbness.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The pattern of worsening weakness with activity and improvement with rest is very concerning for myasthenia gravis. Given your double vision that changes with gaze and the proximal muscle weakness, have you noticed any droopy eyelids or difficulty swallowing solids?

REQUEST TEST: Acetylcholine_receptor_antibodies, Anti-MuSK_antibodies, Repetitive_nerve_stimulation.
